_comment: Which rail each capacitor sits on, and what that rail runs at.
The rated voltage is NOT here -- it is read from the parts list
at run time, so a corrected BOM corrects this too.
Every electrolytic on A21 is a tantalum, and all of them were traced on
the sheets: the +5 LOGIC / +/-12 V decoupling row on sheet 1 zone B7,
the guarded supply row on sheet 5 zone D6, and the two 68 uF reservoirs.
Applied voltages are the generating tables' nominals: Table 2-2 (A19) for
the unguarded rails, Table 2-10 (A17) for the guarded ones, with +5 RLH
taken at the top of its 5.55-6.40 V band.

C10.note: 68 uF 15 V reservoir on the +5 LOGIC rail beside TP4, sheet 1 zone B7 (Table 2-2: 5.2 V nominal). The lowest-rated tantalum on the board, but 5.2 V on 15 V is a comfortable third.

C70.note: 68 uF 15 V reservoir on the +5 LOGIC feed to the 5725A interface connector J7, sheet 4 zone A2.

C11.note: 10 uF 25 V on the +12 V rail, sheet 1 zone B7, beside C41.

C12.note: 10 uF 25 V on the -12 V rail, sheet 1 zone B7. The sheet says NOTE POLARITY ON C12: its positive end is on +5V LOGIC COMMON, the rail being negative. Entered as a magnitude.

C13.note: 10 uF 25 V on the -5 LH rail at TP12, sheet 5 zone D6. The sheet says NOTE POLARITY OF C13: positive end to LH COM. Entered as a magnitude.

C15.note: 10 uF 25 V on the +5 LH rail at TP11, sheet 5 zone D6 (Table 2-10: 5.1 V).

C14.note: 10 uF 25 V on the +5 RLH rail at TP13, sheet 5 zone D6, ahead of choke L1. Table 2-10 gives +5.55 V to +6.40 V; the top of the band is used.

C33.note: 39 uF 20 V relay-supply reservoir after choke L1, sheet 5 zone D5, feeding the +VS of drivers U16/U17 and every relay coil. Top of the +5 RLH band.

C46.note: 1 uF 35 V on the +5 LOGIC supply to the clock comparator U18, sheet 1 zone A6, with C48.

C50.note: 1 uF 35 V from the +5 LOGIC pull-up node at U18's output (R10) to +5V LOGIC COMMON, sheet 1 zone A6, with C49.

C16.note: 10 uF 35 V in the feedback of the LF356 sense amplifier U13 (with R20, 200 k), sheet 3 zone D3 -- a signal integrator rather than a rail. U13 runs from +5 LH / -5 LH, so the capacitor can never see more than about 5 V; entered as that bound.
